{{Top|leg}}
'''Kelligdyd''' was a company that produced various types of heavy weaponry, including [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] like the [[Kelligdyd 25 cannon]] and the [[Kelligdyd 5000 cannon]]. [[Rusher's Brigade]] employed numerous Kelligdyd cannons at the [[Battle of Gazzari]].
